## Rapaso Do Aire (CR 5)

This translucent silver fox bears the scars of a withered corpse, with ragged rents in its spectral hide and pale ghostly fires leaking out of its ravaged flesh.  

**XP** 1,600  
NE Medium undead (incorporeal)  
**Init** +10; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., fearsense 60 ft.; Perception +12  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 18, flat-footed 12 (+2 defelection, +6 Dex)  
**hp** 39 (6d8+12)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +8, **Will** +8  
**Defensive Abilities** incorporeal; **Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 50 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** incorporeal touch +10 (2d6 negative energy damage plus 3d6 fire)  
**Special Attacks** frightening cacophony (DC 15), horrible howl (DC 15)  


**Statistics**


Str—, **Dex** 22, Con —, **Int** 14, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative  
**Skills** Fly +23, Intimidate +11, Perception +12, Stealth +15  
**Languages** Common plus any languages it knew during life  


**Special Abilities**



**Fearsense (Su)** A rapaso do aire can sense the presence of any creature affected by a fear condition (shaken, frightened or panicked) or affected by an ability that is a fear effect. The rapaso do aire also knows what kind of fear the creature is experiencing, within its range.  

**Frightening Cacophony (Su)** As a standard action, a rapaso do aire produces disturbing noises, heralding the death of all that hear it. All living creatures within 30 feet must attempt a DC 15 Will save. A failed save leaves the target frightened for 1d4 rounds. On a successful saving throw, the target is shaken for 1 round and is immune to this ability for 24 hours. If a creature fails a saving throw against frightening cacophony while frightened, the creature becomes panicked for 1 minute and must flee for 1 round. The DC is Charisma-based.  

**Horrible Howl (Su)** As a full-round action a rappose do aire release an unearly howl. All living creatures within 15 feet must attempt a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 3d6 negative energy damage.
